heat.processing: expire old marks and susceptibility; append actual paid units one at a time, testing the effective threshold after every appended unit; a fresh susceptibility application also tests already-held marks
heat.threshold_result: consume exactly the current effective threshold k=8 or 7; each resulting payload is the arithmetic mean of the full source values on those k marks
heat.overflow: consume complete paid sets of k; retain the actual remainder with original source values and absolute deadlines
heat.multiple_ignitions_from_large_declared_a: one independent dose for each fully paid set of current k; maximum-live burn aggregation still prevents additive stacking

burn.dot_aggregation: maximum potency among unexpired burn doses
burn.vulnerability_aggregation: maximum vulnerability among unexpired burn doses, independently of damage potency
burn.direct_application: only sources whose branch or trap payload explicitly declares a direct 4-second burn may bypass heat

poison.lifetime: until this health pool truly terminates or an explicitly designed cleansing operation removes it
poison.qualified_sources: built enabled tower with a legitimate ready attack, or a trap that commits one valid charge
poison.aggregate_storage: sum nonnegative potency-weighted load; do not allocate one permanent object for each accumulated unit
poison.target_defense_and_vulnerability: read current target values for each paid damage segment

contagion.copies: only the explicit newly added dose, never the recipient's historical total load
contagion.target_fanout: declared by branch or trap; every new qualified primary dose remains eligible

ticket_budgets.budget_rule: the source load plus all issued tickets is the full budget of this original application; spending a ticket moves its reserved load, never creates extra load
ticket_budgets.ticket_deadline: original primary application time + 4 seconds; source upgrade, transfer and retarget do not refresh it
ticket_budgets.targets: other legal manifested independent pools within 1.5 tiles; each dose may reach each recipient at most once
ticket_budgets.unspent_ticket: expires unused; do not grant it back as source load or spend it after carrier terminal
ticket_budgets.source_disabled: already attached tickets retain only their original lifetime
ticket_budgets.fission: partition unspent tickets exactly once across child carriers; do not give each child a full set

delayed_once_dose_budget.extra_load: finite amount declared and reserved by the original dose; not a percentage of current total q
delayed_once_dose_budget.aggregation: young buckets with due times; matured load merges into the ordinary aggregate and the pending budget is retired
delayed_once_dose_budget.fission: partition both already applied q and all unpaid maturation load; preserve absolute due times and the once-only flag
delayed_once_dose_budget.full_explicit_poison_cleanse: must clear the affected pending budget as well as its current load unless that monster contract explicitly distinguishes the two

poison.fission: partition load and its potency contribution exactly; fractional quantities or fixed-point remainder distribution must conserve the sum

death_transfer.source_scope: only load tagged at application as inheritable by this actual source instance; do not sweep other poison towers or pre-upgrade load
death_transfer.trigger: true terminal of a poisoned pool; actor removal by fission is not death
death_transfer.amount: half of the remaining eligible source-owned load is a single total transfer budget, split equally across up to two valid recipients
death_transfer.failed_destination: unused transfer budget is lost; no global fallback or reward

poison.susceptibility_interaction: none: unlimited permanent load has no burst threshold; its potency, maturation and transfer budgets are unchanged

frost.explicit_shatter_push: must first end freeze, then resolve the declared displacement; it does not extend hard-control allowance
frost.failed_attempt: consume the attempted meter and start the shared attempt cooldown
frost.during_hard_control_or_immunity: clear freeze reserve; legal cold hits give soft cold trace rather than banked freeze stacks
frost.brittle: read pre-consumption chill snapshot; existing frost freeze or cold trace can qualify; new marks are consumed only by a later attack batch
frost.slow_aggregation: maximum of active slow families, not a product
frost.application_sampling: no extra global target interval; each source uses its explicitly declared application_interval_s for maintained emissions, while each explicitly paid projectile or wave phase can apply once per independent pool
frost.freeze_request_source: the eligible source that submits the current threshold request supplies its explicitly purchased freeze duration; do not borrow the best rank from another source
frost.threshold_request_order: stable world time, source id, attack id and phase order; one shared full threshold is consumed atomically by at most one request
frost.paid_multiwave_example: T03.A2 two explicit cold waves 0.7 seconds apart may each add chill; the second wave is not swallowed by a global target gate
frost.susceptible_attempt_source: a fresh susceptibility event that completes an existing meter uses the most recently applied eligible frost-source payload among consumed marks, with stable IDs breaking exact ties; susceptibility itself contributes no cold or stronger freeze

curse.full_stack_refresh: replace the oldest source mark with the actual new mark; do not refresh all older deadlines
curse.trigger: effective threshold reached or retained, cooldown complete, and either a legal curse application or a legitimate fresh susceptibility application occurs; a UI toggle or save/load is not an event
curse.randomization: deterministic seeded draw derived from persistent encounter seed and immutable attack_id
curse.decision_point: the actual attack commit immediately before issuing damaging payload or launching projectiles
curse.failure_behavior: cancel this uncommitted attack payload and enter its usual recovery/cooldown; retain ordinary movement
curse.multihit_attack: one decision covers all subordinate hits of the same attack_id
curse.canceled_before_commit: does not consume a nonexistent attack draw
curse.applies_to: monster direct damaging attacks explicitly admitted to the attack system
curse.base_reduction_snapshot: outgoing attack amount is determined at attack commit; later curse changes do not rewrite issued attacks

electric.charged_predicate: meter_amount > 0 on a currently legal manifested hostile independent health pool
electric.source_overload_base_override: must be explicit in the source branch or trap payload
electric.mark_contribution: charge_units * snapshotted source_overload_base_damage (full potency mass, no fixed /5 divisor)
electric.mixed_source_overload_base: sum of consumed quantity * source D divided by the actual consumed threshold k (five normally, four with susceptible)
can_add_charge: positive actual damage with element=electric, including primary, appliance contact, one-hop bounce and overload
an explicitly declared independent paid charging pulse or trap application even when it is not a damaging packet
cannot_add_charge: non-electric damage merely using the spiritual defense channel
missed, blocked, canceled or zero-actual-damage electric packets without an explicitly separate paid charge payload
duplicate receipts of an already committed electric impact
electric.threshold_state: at most one ready request per living pool reserves exactly the current effective threshold k of live charge units; preserve all paid surplus with original expiry
electric.full_ready_new_hits: append the actual new charge_units and its own expiry even while a request is ready; never discard paid overflow and never refresh older lots
electric.independent_appliance_pulse: explicit purchased primary emission; same source/attack phase/pool dedupe across overlapping appliance sensing domains
electric.meter_amount: sum of positive unexpired charge_units, including reserved and unreserved amounts
electric.primary_charge_application: a positive normal electric impact grants max(1, explicitly declared native charge_units) exactly once; a native +2 replaces generic +1, not +3; a zero-damage packet grants none unless it has a separately paid pure-charge payload
electric.expiry_order: remove lots with expires_at <= current world time before threshold checks and wave snapshots
electric.storage: aggregate compatible finite-lived lots by expiry and potency/ownership; no per-frame immortal token allocation

feedback.formula: each distinct pool taking positive actual overload damage receives exactly 1 charge; total generated feedback = positive-hit pool count
feedback.feedback_source_overload_base: this wave effective D, without recursive potency attenuation
feedback.feedback_contribution: one full source-D potency mass per real feedback unit
feedback.dead_recipient: record one generated charge for each positive hit, then remove that charge and all prior status in atomic true-terminal cleanup; no dead-pool request survives
feedback.zero_actual_damage: no feedback, no ordinary bounce and no synthetic charge
feedback.balance_basis: finite-health one/two-pool normal encounters first; full crowd cascades are an intended payoff and lose targets, relay nodes and local coefficients as real deaths commit
feedback.uncharged_outside_network: does not receive this wave merely because it is close; a real primary/paid charging effect must first mark it

susceptible.name: 易感

sources.condition: one second of actual continuous eligible spot exposure
a fresh successful main-rule event for this actual rule-subject pool while it is in the legal sound domain
sources.target_scope: the one actual subject health_pool_id; root lineage identifies the event but never fans this application out to all children

sources.condition: one valid prepaid trap activation on its primary pool

susceptible.aggregation: boolean status with the latest live expiry; multiple sources never lower a threshold by two; each source retains its own actual expiry
susceptible.expiry_order: remove expired susceptibility and marks before resolving new applications at that world time
check_events: a legal application of the corresponding meter
a fresh legitimate susceptible application or its paid maintained refresh
susceptible.gain_with_existing_marks: evaluate the new lower threshold immediately once after the eligible event, respecting freeze/curse attempt cooldown and the electric queue; do not wait for an invented extra hit
susceptible.burn_and_electric_strength: average the full snapshotted source payloads of the actual consumed quantity; reducing 8 to 7 or 5 to 4 does not reduce explosion strength
susceptible.frost: consume the effective threshold of real marks; slow per mark and existing control/attempt rules stay unchanged
susceptible.curse: trigger at three live marks while susceptible, but keep the four-mark capacity and -4% direct outgoing attack per real mark; three marks mean -12%, not -16%
susceptible.expiration: do not erase marks, extend timers, cancel a burn/freeze already paid for, or undo committed damage; a not-yet-consumed electric reservation is revalidated against the current threshold
susceptible.no_retroactive_attack_failure: susceptibility from an attack-commit reaction cannot rewrite that already committed attack
susceptible.fission: inherit only the remaining time on each eligible child; do not multiply meter quantities
susceptible.visibility: show effective threshold beside current meter and distinct susceptibility expiry; poison shows no changed threshold

stages: apply permanent rule facts to base defense
take strongest live generic break for this channel
resolve raw packet through its one defense channel

rule_cooperation_source.condition: a real main-rule success for that root while the broadcaster is active; recipients must currently be in its valid sound domain

damage.primary_dedupe: one legitimate attack phase per independent health_pool_id
named_paid_exceptions: a previously reserved poison maturity budget
electric_positive_hit_feedback: each positive electric hit applies its declared charge once and can ready later waves
damage.exception_rule: electric waves have no total feedback charge cap and no hop-count cap; a wave consumes its actual k=5 or 4 seed units and each positive-hit pool returns one charge. Other ordinary on-hit recursion remains prohibited.
damage.same_batch_death: resolve the full already-committed hit batch before fission or terminal settlement
damage.secondary_scope: ordinary secondary procs only; electric_positive_hit_feedback overrides the charge/overload recursion ban but does not create an extra ordinary bounce after overload
damage.electric_hit_charge_order: resolve the legitimate electric damage packet, apply its one declared charge grant, queue threshold requests after the current atomic batch; no recursive same-call-stack overload

zone_toll.source_tower_cell_damage: explicit per branch; may exceed trap damage
zone_toll.deadline_update: ordinary toll writes hit_time + 2; a genuine phase-event toll ignores prior deadlines exactly once for that event and rewrites every actually charged cell to arrival_time + 2
zone_toll.overlapping_same_family: evaluate each currently legal source packet against this target current channel defense, source penetration and vulnerability; choose the greatest resolved damage and settle exactly that one base toll
zone_toll.overlapping_different_families: only if the design explicitly declares them distinct; source IDs alone do not create a new family
zone_toll.spatial_model: half-open fixed world cells; count positive-length segment intersections, not zero-length corner touches
zone_toll.movement_reference: one canonical combat reference trajectory per health pool; body width and shared body-part count do not multiply tolls
zone_toll.continuous_resolution: trace the real path in time order and check the cell, field existence, height and deadline at each crossing
zone_toll.discontinuous_resolution: for true_teleport, shadow_jump and mirror_transfer, trace the straight audit segment between actual committed departure and arrival; use the union of positive-length segment cells and the actual departure/arrival half-open cells, deduplicated; settle each active valid damage cell once. This deliberately represents phase punishment, not a physical ground path
zone_toll.stationary_resolution: while inside an active legal cell, one toll can recur when its existing deadline expires
zone_toll.same_cell_teleport: a genuine nonzero phase displacement within one valid damage cell pays that cell once and refreshes its deadline; a zero-displacement/canceled proposal is not a phase toll event
zone_toll.fission: copy all unexpired parent cell deadlines to each new pool, without cloning already committed damage
zone_toll.late_field_or_rebuild: cannot reset an existing ledger entry; a newly covered cell without an entry can deliver its normal first toll

test_example.assumption: no defenses/vulnerability; all four active legal cells have raw damage 3 in every movement mode

zone_toll.equal_resolved_damage_tiebreak: stable source ID, then attack and phase ID; never settle all tied sources
zone_toll.selection_and_commit: choose without dealing candidate damage or consuming candidate on-hit receipts; commit one winner and one shared pool/cell/family deadline
zone_toll.independent_declared_effects: a source explicitly scheduled status pulse, qualified residence reward or other separately paid sibling ability is tested by its own source contract even when another source wins the base toll; this grants no second base toll and no recursion

requires: real departure and committed legal arrival positions
a real hostile independent health pool
phase_contract.audit_geometry: straight departure-to-arrival segment in store coordinates; not shortest navigable path, not mirror graph path, not Euclidean distance divided by cell size
phase_contract.cell_intersection: union of positive-length audit-segment intersections, actual departure half-open cell, and actual arrival half-open cell; deduplicate. Intermediate corner-only touches do not count; an actual endpoint on a boundary belongs to its own half-open cell and is included once
phase_contract.height: this explicitly phase-aware toll audits projected transition position independently of the nonexistent intermediate travel height; ordinary continuous high-air movement remains subject to actual field height
phase_contract.solid_occupancy: only actual active damage domains on legal walkable floor contribute; wall/shelf/cabinet volume and uncovered gaps produce no damage cell
phase_contract.wall_between_endpoints: does not stop the symbolic audit segment, but the wall itself never counts as a zone; no ordinary projectile, trap or DOT gains wall penetration
phase_contract.field_snapshot_time: after legal arrival is committed and any explicitly phase-aware charged-zone activation is committed, before the arriving pool starts a new attack
phase_contract.damage_formula: sum of one winning legal resolved packet for each distinct valid covered cell; if all cells have identical raw D and defense, raw total = number_of_cells * D
phase_contract.refresh: after atomic phase toll settlement, all actually charged cells receive arrival_world_time + cell_period_s; all unaffected cells retain their previous deadlines
phase_contract.repeat_delivery_of_same_event: zero new damage and no deadline refresh
phase_contract.another_real_phase_before_two_seconds: new event can pay the same effective cells again and refresh them once; this is the deliberate displacement penalty
phase_contract.simultaneous_ordinary_arrival_toll: absorbed into this cell phase packet; do not pay both phase and ordinary arrival for the same cell in the same event
phase_contract.endpoint_specialization: specialize legal coverage, reserved landing reliability and separately paid short root, not an extra phase/landing damage multiplier; each settled cell still uses its ordinary unit damage
forbidden_implied_interactions: appliance contact crossings in the absent middle
ordinary collision or blocking along the audit segment
phase_contract.canceled_or_preview_only_move: no toll, no cooldown refresh, no trap charge debit and no valid-phase receipt; reject zero displacement before writing any receipt
phase_contract.multiple_real_legs: each separately committed phase event audits its own real endpoints; replaying a rendering frame is not another leg
phase_contract.same_batch_terminal: settle this entire already-committed toll batch before fission/terminal rules; no split can erase the paid line
phase_contract.phase_exit_targetability: phase producers must commit a legal manifested exit window; this tax resolves at the exit before new attack work, not against an invented mid-travel actor
phase_contract.baseline_guarantee: a committed true phase across k active legal cells pays k ordinary cell packets even though residence time is zero and old per-cell cooldowns are live; no guarantee exists for an uncovered or solid cell

phase_aware_trap_activation.condition: an armed R09 has a valid paid charge and the real phase audit intersects at least one legal cell of its actual floor footprint
phase_aware_trap_activation.debit: at most one charge per trap instance and phase_event_id
phase_aware_trap_activation.activation: commit the explicit eight-second R09 field before the same event selects winning cells
phase_aware_trap_activation.already_active: do not debit or restart its field merely because another phase arrives
phase_aware_trap_activation.scope: this is an explicit phase-aware zone source exception, not a rule for generic floor traps
phase_aware_trap_activation.extra_branch_effects: R09 A may evaluate its own paid traversal bonus for at least two distinct actually charged cells inside its field, using its shared two-second bonus cooldown; R09 B residence only uses real elapsed presence

zone_toll.design_role: movement improves hit frequency and reliable coverage; the same authored cell deals the same resolved unit damage for stationary, walking, dash and genuine phase settlement

persistent_field.damage_timing: pay the same active world-time interval regardless of render frame rate
persistent_field.motion_resolution: evaluate actual presence in the field over time; do not assign a full residence tick merely for crossing between sampled positions
persistent_field.finite_field_snapshot: an explicitly launched independent finite field keeps only its originally declared duration and payload
persistent_field.balance: nominal radius is at least one tile; recover shelf-occluded usable area via bounded lawful expansion, preserve actual residence/DPS/duty cycle
persistent_field.phase_endpoint_residence: only time actually spent at legal departure or arrival positions counts; the symbolic phase-audit middle contributes no residence

electric_network.scheduling: FIFO by original valid ready time, then stable pool ID; each wave processes one seed, and newly feedback-ready pools wait until a later network tick; skip currently ineligible seeds without extending expiry
electric_network.ready_request_payload: actual pool, current threshold k, ready time and immutable reserved charge-lot quantities; revalidate prior to wave
atomic_wave_steps: expire statuses, susceptibility and charge; revalidate changed thresholds and stale reservations
choose one living targetable ready seed by ready_time then stable pool ID for this 0.25-second tick
snapshot the current legal charged-pool / powered-appliance graph before consuming seed charge; visit its entire connected component
for each recipient snapshot local one-edge N including itself and local E; no global component multiplier
consume exactly reserved k=5 or 4 real units and average their full source-D values; preserve surplus
commit one spiritual electric packet D*(N_i+E_i) per eligible independent pool in the same snapshot, clipping applied HP loss to its actual remaining HP for reporting
each positive actual damage recipient generates exactly one feedback unit with source D equal to this wave D, without a per-wave total charge cap
complete the atomic batch, then true death / dependent-child cleanup / fission; dead pools lose charges, ready requests and graph membership
revalidate surviving requests and create requests for newly full surviving pools; the next wave waits for the next network tick and recomputes the graph
electric_network.formula: raw_damage_i = weighted_mean_source_D_of_the_k_consumed_seed_units * (N_i + E_i); k = current effective threshold
electric_network.count_identity: independent health_pool_id, never collider parts or shared root IDs
electric_network.N_i: one plus the number of directly adjacent legal charged independent pool nodes at this wave snapshot; includes recipient itself even though seed charge will be consumed next
electric_network.E_i: number of distinct directly adjacent enabled actually powered registered appliance nodes; distant component devices may relay but do not inflate this local coefficient
electric_network.target_set: all legal charged independent health pools in the seed spatial connected component, including remote pools outside the seed radius reached through any number of valid pool/device edges
electric_network.temporary_untargetability: defer while keeping original mark expiry; no untargetable new area hits, and no frozen queue lifetime
cancel_ready_when: cleansing or expiry removes any reserved quantity
effective threshold changes with susceptible gain/expiry; release surviving reservation and requeue only at the new threshold
genuine fission replaces parent; partition real quantities and full source-D mass once
electric_network.moving_between_waves: recompute all current edges, device power, charge presence and local multipliers for every wave; no stale component snapshots
electric_network.inherited_fission_ready: partition real quantities and potency with absolute expiry; no copied reservation, and a child queues only at its actual effective threshold

bounce.recipients: one other currently charged legal independent pool; nearest valid distance then stable identity
bounce.source_overload_base: the originating primary/contact source declared D, without secondary potency attenuation
bounce.aoe_budget: one ordinary extra arc for the entire multi-target phase, not one arc per primary recipient; simultaneous multi-appliance induction domains are one source phase
bounce.selection: after this phase primary packets and their charge grants, examine legal direct pool-pool pairs from actual primary impact positions; choose the nearest pair, then stable primary/recipient IDs; never count a device relay as an ordinary one-hop bounce
bounce.appliance_contact_budget: each genuinely separate appliance entry damage event has one phase budget; duplicate entry callbacks share it
bounce.trigger_scope: only the explicitly allowed one-hop bounce after an eligible normal electric primary or actual appliance contact; overload packets never spawn this extra bounce
bounce.charge_application: one positive bounce damage packet grants exactly one charge unit; it does not copy any historical source meter

appliance_contact.contact_domain: union of the real one-tile surface domain and explicitly bound valid copper-rail extensions for that one appliance
appliance_contact.true_entry_event_order: latch a genuine outside-to-inside movement entry; apply an explicitly paid entry-trap charge grant such as R16; if now charged, resolve one appliance contact damage and its one charge unit; then permit at most one bounce
appliance_contact.multiple_rail_parts: entering another part of the same appliance union is not a new entry; must first leave the entire union
appliance_contact.one_event_dedupe: health_pool_id + actual movement entry ID + appliance_id; no reactive electric damage can manufacture another movement ID
appliance_contact.phase_real_arrival_contact: the actual outside-to-inside departure/arrival membership change may qualify once if the actual committed destination is in the union; the imaginary middle never qualifies

never_implicit_devices: duplicate workpoint on the same device
appliances.contact_and_network_height: ground and low-air recipients can couple to these registered devices; high-air coupling requires an explicitly added capable device field

excluded_appliance_ids.reason: physical terminal registration and wiring pending; disabled

excluded_fixture_ids.reason: distribution source, not an extra appliance

appliances.geometry_authority: traps_facilities_td05.json appliances: registered real rectangles and unique appliance_id mapping
appliances.distance_metric: shortest unobstructed distance from the recipient combat reference point to the registered appliance footprint surface, not distance to its center

example.reachable_remote_example: A--AP1--AP2--B links the whole component; B still counts only its own direct pool/device neighbors

outward_charge_transfer.event: a genuinely moving marked pool exits the real powered appliance sensing domain of this branch
outward_charge_transfer.mark_choice: earliest-expiring eligible native unreserved charge lots totaling one real charge_unit; split proportionally, preserve deadlines/potency, and move at most once
outward_charge_transfer.failure: if no legal uncharged recipient exists, move nothing and do not consume the transfer cooldown
outward_charge_transfer.sensing_distance_reference: registered real appliance footprint surface; copper rails do not relocate or expand this sensing radius
outward_charge_transfer.transferred_mark_tag: received_by_outward_transfer; ineligible for another outward transfer, while still contributing normally to charged state and overload
outward_charge_transfer.insufficient_native_charge: if eligible native unreserved amount is less than one, move nothing and do not consume cooldown

nodes: each legal manifested charged independent hostile health_pool_id
each enabled actually powered registered appliance_id
graph.pool_pool_edge: combat reference points within 2.5 tiles and permitted actual height/line of sight
graph.pool_appliance_edge: pool reference point to actual registered appliance surface within 2.5 tiles, compatible height and an unobstructed straight coupling segment
graph.appliance_appliance_edge: two distinct enabled powered registered devices have surfaces within 2.5 tiles joined by an unobstructed straight segment; ignore the endpoint device solids only at their own surface exits, not intervening fixtures
graph.surface_distance: minimum straight Euclidean distance over visible legal surface points, not path length routed around an occluding shelf and not distance between appliance centers
graph.traversal: complete BFS/DFS of every legal edge in the current component with visited-node dedupe; do not greedily select only one neighbor or stop at the seed circle
graph.independent_roots: spatially eligible hostile pools from different active roots may connect; root identity remains separate for rewards and permanent rules

electric_network.waiting_overflow: new positive charge has no stored-meter cap; reserve only current k per request and preserve all other real quantities with their original deadlines
electric_network.reservation_policy: reserve earliest-expiring live units first, then stable application identity; split a lot only by exact proportional quantity and potency

charge_lot_contract.potency_invariant: potency_mass = charge_units * source_overload_base_damage; wave D = consumed potency_mass / consumed charge_units
charge_lot_contract.merge_only_when: expiry, source potency, attribution, transfer eligibility and reservation identity all match; merging does not change total quantity or contribution
charge_lot_contract.transfer: preserve original applied/expiry times, source potency and attribution; assign a deterministic child lot identity only to distinguish the transferred fraction
charge_lot_contract.feedback: new identity wave_id + recipient_pool_id + feedback; applied=wave time, expiry=wave time+8, source_D=wave_D
charge_lot_contract.precision: reference fixtures use exact rational values; runtime uses sufficient precision and conservative comparisons without rounding charge gains upward

threshold_consumption.at_ready_creation: reserve exactly current k, ordered by earliest expiry, applied time and immutable lot ID
threshold_consumption.partial_last_lot: reserve only the required quantity and proportional full potency mass; leave the rest unchanged
threshold_consumption.while_waiting: new hits append independent lots and never refresh or upgrade old reservations
threshold_consumption.threshold_changed: cancel old priority, release live reserved amounts and reserve current k anew at current time; losing susceptible while holding four cannot produce a five-unit explosion
threshold_consumption.at_wave: validate same effective k and all reserved units alive/unexpired; consume atomically and divide their summed potency mass by k
threshold_consumption.surplus: preserve unconsumed units and their expiry; fresh full surplus receives a new request time
threshold_consumption.fission: cancel parent reservation, partition actual charge and full source-D mass once, then evaluate children
threshold_consumption.dedupe: wave_id + ready_request_id may be consumed only once

chain_progress_and_scope.intended_amplification: with five or more positive recipients (four with susceptible), total charge can stay level or grow; this is allowed crowd resonance
chain_progress_and_scope.finite_health_case: a living ready seed is included in its wave and, if vulnerable, takes positive damage; finite HP and positive D imply eventual deaths without external healing/new spawns. Each real death removes its charge and graph node before another wave.
chain_progress_and_scope.scope_of_termination_claim: finite-health fixtures with positive damage, no healing, no new input/spawns and no immunity; do not claim a charge-conservation proof or an unconditional limit for arbitrary scripts
chain_progress_and_scope.zero_damage_case: zero damage creates no feedback; explicitly paid primary chargers may still add their declared budget
chain_progress_and_scope.infinite_health_fixture: can intentionally sustain a cascade; test only with an explicit observation horizon, never use that fixture to impose a gameplay charge cap
chain_progress_and_scope.scheduler_is_not_a_charge_cap: one wave per 0.25 seconds makes the chain observable and avoids recursive call stacks; all real overflow is retained

identity_and_fission.health_pool_id: damage, status meters and target cooldowns
identity_and_fission.root_encounter_id: encounter slot, lineage, permanent rule facts and unique settlement
identity_and_fission.aoe_shared_parts: one damage packet per shared pool
identity_and_fission.aoe_independent_children: one packet per independently eligible pool
identity_and_fission.before_fission: resolve the entire committed damage batch; zero-health pools cannot split
conserve: all reserved and overflow electric charge_units with proportional potency contributions
identity_and_fission.status_tokens: partition existing units and fractional quantities once, preserving each absolute expiry and contribution; do not copy a full parent meter or queued ready request to each child
identity_and_fission.cooldowns: all children inherit absolute relevant shared control and zone deadlines
identity_and_fission.already_active_timed_effects: inherit original deadlines; never extend duration merely because a new actor is created
identity_and_fission.effective_durability_budget: also account for child defense, attack concurrency, movement and cleanup; health conservation alone is insufficient

terminal_relations.shared_parts: parent pool terminal ends the parts
terminal_relations.dependent_summons: true mother terminal stops and dissolves them; no extra kill proc or reward
terminal_relations.independent_creations: stop new production but retain existing independent children until cleared
terminal_relations.fission_replacements: parent actor removal is not root terminal; all surviving children must be resolved

identity_and_fission.full_capacity_behavior: cancel that spawn attempt; no invulnerable waiting or unbounded deferred population

controls.hard_control_episode_origin: first accepted hard control; overlaps and successive sources cannot move its end
visible_feedback: curse attack reduction and misfortune probability
electric charge meter with fractional progress, valid component connections and queued overload
local N+E and the next wave effective D preview
zone cooldown and a real phase audit line with counted cells and reset timer
paper hold remaining time and reassembly
pre-shift trap stock, installed remaining charges and opening lock

position_root.distinction_from_freeze: position root fixes location only; freeze additionally fixes facing and cancels uncommitted attacks

explicit_source.damage: ordinary same-cell unit damage only; short root adds no phase or arrival multiplier
explicit_source.requires: a genuinely completed published landing into the armed legal projected cell, eligible actual height and controllable body; includes authored jump/emerge landings and registered true phases, but never invents an ability
explicit_source.sequence: commit the actual landing; ordinary jump/emerge pays only its normal actual cell if due, whereas registered true phase performs its own line audit and refresh; then request root within shared control budget

paper_interception.clock_origin: first accepted interception at t; release by t+1 and forbid a new paper interception before t+6
paper_interception.all_source_scope: all towers, slots, rebuilt dolls and upgraded dolls share this target clock
paper_interception.early_release: death, legal bypass, lost eligibility or doll retirement can release earlier; never refund time for a replacement doll
paper_interception.reassembly_origin: actual retirement or destruction of that slot doll
paper_interception.separate_from_stun: ground obstruction and an eligible attack target; does not erase attacks already legal against player, ranged attacks or area attacks
paper_interception.concurrent_control: timer runs during freeze/root; no pause or extension to either control episode
paper_interception.pathing: ineligible/recently intercepted monsters pass or route past the doll without being forced into another hold; paper bodies cannot create a permanent wall
paper_interception.primary_pressure_target: return to pursuing the player on release; neither a newly spawned doll nor another nearby slot resets that pursuit decision

scope: TD05: uncapped electric feedback with finite-health deaths, equal per-zone displacement toll, susceptibility, compensated floor coverage, and short paper interception
replaces: TD04 feedback charge budget and potency attenuation, phase-specific damage multipliers, uncorrected clipped coverage, and long-lived paper blocking

applies_to: circular secondary damage or status reach
effective_floor_domain.field_center: a legal ground projection/placement point on actual walkable floor, not the center of a shelf or cabinet
effective_floor_domain.effective_domain: expanded lawful field shape intersect reachable actual walkable center domain and legal height/LOS; subtract solid occupancy enlarged by the actual body radius for collision, not enlarged field-edge exclusion
effective_floor_domain.anchor_and_emitter: the tower stays on a legal fixture anchor; use a registered outward side/top emitter and a legal projected floor center within its cast range
effective_floor_domain.own_fixture_ray_exit: a registered emitter may leave its own hosting fixture from the authorized outward face; this does not permit crossing other fixtures or walls
effective_floor_domain.blocked_center_policy: preview and choose the nearest valid reachable floor point within the actual cast radius; if none exists, reject that field placement/cast and do not debit an unfulfilled trap charge
effective_floor_domain.reachability: at least one actual reachable position for the intended enemy body must lie in the effective field; test connectivity using that body footprint, not merely a colored circle overlap
effective_floor_domain.ordinary_body_check: a radius-0.3 reference disk has a navigably connected legal center in the field and its whole disk fits walkable terrain; this example never proves larger bodies can enter
effective_floor_domain.different_body_sizes: repeat reachability with the actual authored body radius/width for larger monsters; reject inaccessible claimed counter matchups
preview: usable-area compensation result and any rejected placement
effective_floor_domain.no_fake_area: solid fixture area is never counted as usable floor coverage or as a floor damage cell
effective_floor_domain.moving_fields: field centers follow actual allowed movement and terrain clipping; crossing a fixture or jumping directly through one is not permitted merely because the effect follows a target

area_compensation.purpose: recover useful area lost to shelf/counter occupancy around a legal projection, rather than quietly accepting a nominal circle that mostly covers furniture
area_compensation.target_area: pi * nominal_radius^2 of reachable legal reference-body centers; the body center lies inside the field but the whole body need not lie inside its circle
area_compensation.collision_test: the whole reference body must remain outside actual solids and inside traversable world, with lawful height/LOS and a connected approach
area_compensation.center: keep the verified projected floor center; first use an allowed side/top emitter or another legal hang point, then expand from this actual center
area_compensation.radius_choice: smallest radius at or above nominal radius satisfying target usable center-area within declared numerical tolerance
area_compensation.unobstructed_case: no extra radius for the reference body itself: its center domain already has area pi*r^2
area_compensation.failure: report actual achievable area and reject that placement/choose another legal projection when the cap cannot meet the target; no silent damage/DPS increase
area_compensation.preview: show actual expanded legal boundary, actual radius, reachable area and blocked cells before payment; retain same DPS, duration, target caps and status cadence

revision_validation_targets: normal and true-phase settlement use identical damage per counted cell
a distinct committed phase ignores prior cell cooldowns once and rewrites arrival+2; duplicate/zero/canceled moves do nothing
finite HP one/two-pool electric encounters, early deaths, graph fragmentation and six/eight-pool payoff are all measured
every positive overload hit returns exactly one charge without a per-wave budget or source-D attenuation
dead pools cannot emit pending waves; the next wave counts the surviving graph
susceptible thresholds are 7/3/3/4, nonstacking, with unchanged paid burst strength and no poison threshold
expiry invalidates four-unit reservations, and a fresh susceptibility event can complete existing marks
all real shelf anchors compensate usable floor area within bounded radius or explicitly fail placement
paper intercept never extends beyond one second across any source, and rebuild does not reset the target clock
trap items and refills are purchased and loaded before opening; all replenishment/moving/upgrade/repair routes reject while open
seven-day inventory and money replay retains actual assets and stock, then clears the week atomically
